description: This file contains client-side scripts for the 'Sales' form in ERPNext, including a class 'SellingController' that manages sales transactions, address handling, discounts, commissions, batch and serial number management, and UI interactions related to sales documents.

classes.name: erpnext.selling.SellingController
classes.description: Controller class managing sales transactions, address handling, discounts, commissions, batch/serial management, and UI interactions for sales documents.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the selling controller, fetching commission rates for sales partner and sales person.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Actions to perform when the form loads, including setting up queries.

methods.name: setup_queries
methods.description: Configures various query filters for form fields like customer, lead, item_code, batch_no, etc.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form UI, toggling display elements and setting dynamic labels.

methods.name: customer
methods.description: Fetches and applies customer party details and price list.

methods.name: customer_address
methods.description: Displays customer address and sets taxes based on address.

methods.name: shipping_address_name
methods.description: Displays shipping address and sets taxes accordingly.

methods.name: dispatch_address_name
methods.description: Displays dispatch address.

methods.name: sales_partner
methods.description: Applies pricing rules based on sales partner.

methods.name: campaign
methods.description: Applies pricing rules based on campaign.

methods.name: selling_price_list
methods.description: Sets price list and updates labels.

methods.name: discount_percentage
methods.description: Resets discount amount and applies discount based on percentage.

methods.name: discount_amount
methods.description: Resets discount percentage and applies discount based on amount.

methods.name: apply_discount_on_item
methods.description: Calculates and applies discount on an item.

methods.name: commission_rate
methods.description: Calculates commission rate.

methods.name: total_commission
methods.description: Calculates total commission based on eligible amount.

methods.name: allocated_percentage
methods.description: Calculates allocated amount and incentive for sales personnel.

methods.name: sales_person
methods.description: Calculates incentives for a sales person.

methods.name: warehouse
methods.description: Handles warehouse, serial, and batch number validation and updates.

methods.name: toggle_editable_price_list_rate
methods.description: Enables editing of price list rate if defaults allow.

methods.name: calculate_commission
methods.description: Calculates commission and validates rate.

methods.name: calculate_contribution
methods.description: Calculates contribution of sales team members.

methods.name: calculate_incentive
methods.description: Calculates incentives for sales personnel.

methods.name: batch_no
methods.description: Handles batch number assignment for items.

methods.name: set_dynamic_labels
methods.description: Sets dynamic labels for the form, including product bundle help.

methods.name: set_product_bundle_help
methods.description: Displays help message for product bundle items.

methods.name: company_address
methods.description: Fetches and displays company address.

methods.name: conversion_factor
methods.description: Calculates conversion factor and sets batch number if applicable.

methods.name: set_batch_number
methods.description: Determines and sets batch number for an item.

methods.name: _set_batch_number
methods.description: Internal method to fetch and set batch number.

methods.name: update_auto_repeat_reference
methods.description: Updates auto repeat document reference.
